title: A prescribed finite etale generic extension has an etale residue-field model
statement: Let S be an irreducible scheme [def-pc-scheme] with generic point eta_S [def-sc-generic-point]. Let L be a field and let y_eta: Spec L to Spec kappa(eta_S) be a finite etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-residue-field]. There exist a scheme T, an etale map g:T to S, a generic point eta of T with g(eta)=eta_S, and an isomorphism r: Spec kappa(eta) to Spec L such that r followed by y_eta and the canonical residue-field point of S equals the canonical residue-field point of T followed by g.

proof.text: Equip L with the algebra structure induced by Spec.preimage y_eta. The affine Etale criterion gives Algebra.Etale, and the Mathlib formally unramified finiteness and formally etale field separability lemmas give a finite separable extension. Apply the already proved Scheme.exists_etale_neighbourhood_prescribed_residueField to obtain an etale morphism phi:U to S, u over eta_S, and a compatible residue-field isomorphism e:L to kappa(u).

The closed source instance LocallyQuasiFinite.of_etale and Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton make the set-theoretic fibre over eta_S discrete. By isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen choose an open V of U with V intersect phi^{-1}({eta_S}) = {u}. Set T=V, eta=u as a point of V, and g=V.ι followed by phi. The open immersion and phi are etale, so g is etale, and its fibre over eta_S is exactly {eta}. This uses only the proved quasi-finiteness tool, without importing the stronger scheme fibre-decomposition statement.

Etale morphisms are flat and locally of finite presentation. Mathlib UniversallyOpen.of_flat and Scheme.Hom.isOpenMap therefore make g open. For the continuous open map g, IsOpenMap.preimage_closure_eq_closure_preimage gives closure({eta}) = closure(g^{-1}({eta_S})) = g^{-1}(closure({eta_S})) = T, so eta is generic. Its image is eta_S by construction. This uses the closed Mathlib instances directly, not the unstated DAG lemma lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map, and requires neither reducedness nor Noetherianity.

Compose e with the residue-field isomorphism of the open immersion V.ι at eta to get d:L isomorphic to kappa_T(eta), and take r=Spec(d). Compatibility of e and residueFieldMap_comp give (residueFieldCongr(g eta=eta_S)).inv followed by g.residueFieldMap eta = Spec.preimage(y_eta) followed by d.hom. Applying Spec, residueFieldCongr_fromSpecResidueField and SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField proves the required equality. All identifications, including the prescribed algebra structure, are retained.

proof_origin.note: V2: shorter route below the unit level using the already proved prescribed residue-field neighbourhood and closed quasi-finiteness tools. The Lean proof is complete and uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The unit realized lists are empty; no fixed unit step is bypassed. Second reading: openness comes directly from Mathlib UniversallyOpen.of_flat and Scheme.Hom.isOpenMap; removed the citation to the DAG open-map lemma, which has no Lean declaration. External closed tools used in step 2 are LocallyQuasiFinite.of_etale and Scheme.Hom.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton.

mathlib_searches.query: A finite etale extension of the residue field at a generic point of an irreducible scheme extends to an etale scheme with that generic residue field
finite etale generic residue field extension spreads to etale scheme with prescribed generic residue field
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Algebra.exists_etale_bijective_residueFieldMap_and_map_eq_mul_and_isCoprime, Algebra.exists_etale_of_isEtaleAt and Algebra.Etale.exists_subalgebra_fg. None states the required scheme model.

Two hits in UniversalFactorizationRing and Etale/Locus; no prescribed generic scheme model. Local source search also checked SpreadFiniteSeparableExtension, GenericPointedEtaleExtension and EtaleGenericIrreducibleNeighbourhood. The first two require integrality and the last requires Noetherian hypotheses.

from.place: proof steps 1 and 2 and the residue-field compatibility in step 3

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_generic_residue_field_model {S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IrreducibleSpace S] {L : Type u} [Field L]
    (yη : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶
      Spec (CommRingCat.of (S.residueField (genericPoint S))))
    [IsFinite yη] [Etale yη] :
    ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (η : T)
      (r : Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField η)) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)),
      Etale g ∧ IsGenericPoint η Set.univ ∧ g η = genericPoint S ∧
      r.hom ≫ yη ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint S) =
        T.fromSpecResidueField η ≫ g
